faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.q1: How fast will you contact me?
faq.a1: A Seedrix consultant will contact you within 10 minutes of submitting your details — by phone or WhatsApp, in the language you used on the form.
faq.a2: All seven Emirates: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah, and Fujairah. Sessions are delivered at home or online.
faq.a3: We review credentials and experience before any match. Trainers for special educational support and shadow teaching are credential-verified before they are introduced to a family.
faq.a4: Yes. Tell your consultant if the match isn't right. Seedrix may also reassign a qualified trainer when needed, to the same qualification standard.
faq.q5: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a5: Card, bank transfer, or an approved Tabby or Tamara plan. Seedrix does not accept cash. Every payment is confirmed by an official Seedrix invoice.
faq.q6: Can I cancel or reschedule a session?
faq.a6: Give written notice at least 24 hours before a scheduled VIP, one-to-one, or online session. Up to 2 reschedules per calendar month are permitted with adequate notice. Late cancellations are deducted from the package.

languages.title: Languages
languages.covers: English, Arabic, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, and further languages on request — from first words through exam-level fluency.
languages.who: Children, teens, and adults who need a language for school, work, relocation, or family life in the UAE.

school-support.title: School academic support
school-support.covers: UAE/Ministry, British, and American curricula. Major subjects, grade-level catch-up, and ongoing academic follow-up.
school-support.who: Students who need structured help keeping pace with school — or stretching ahead — with a trainer who knows the curriculum.

special-needs.title: Special educational support
special-needs.covers: Autism support, developmental and behavioral support, speech and communication, writing difficulties, and reading and learning difficulties.
special-needs.who: Families who need a trainer experienced in specialised educational support, matched carefully rather than from a generic pool.

shadow-teacher.title: Shadow teacher / school support
shadow-teacher.covers: In-classroom support tailored to your child's needs, coordinated with the family and, where appropriate, the school.
shadow-teacher.who: Families whose child needs a dedicated adult alongside them during the school day.

test-prep.title: Test preparation

test-prep.who: Students and adults preparing for a named exam, with a trainer who teaches to that paper — not a generic English or maths class.

online-home-tutoring.title: Online & home tutoring
online-home-tutoring.covers: The same vetted trainers, delivered wherever it works: at home as VIP tutoring, or online across the UAE.
online-home-tutoring.who: Families who want the flexibility to choose the room — yours or a screen — without changing the quality of the match.

aboutPage.title: About Seedrix Training
aboutPage.mission: To connect families across the UAE with vetted, independent tutors — in languages, school support, test preparation, and specialised educational support — delivered at home or online, with a process you can trust.
aboutPage.background: Seedrix Training (trading as Seedrix for Training / Seedrix Language Learning Center) is operated by Seedrix LLC. We are a training and tutoring provider, not a school: we match you with independent trainers we have reviewed, then manage the engagement, schedule, and invoicing.
aboutPage.vetting: Every trainer is reviewed before we make a match: relevant teaching or subject credentials, experience with the age group and curriculum, and a conversation with Seedrix. For special educational support and shadow teaching, we verify credentials before any introduction. If the match isn't right, we reassign to the same standard.
aboutPage.license: Seedrix LLC — License No. 2648158.01, Shams Free Zone, Sharjah, UAE. Licensed activity includes training.

termsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
termsPage.intro: Please read these Terms & Conditions carefully. By submitting a registration or completing a payment with Seedrix, you agree to be bound by them.
termsPage.c1: Seedrix may update curriculum, materials, or reassign a qualified Trainer as needed, consistent with the qualification standards applied to all Trainers.
termsPage.c2: The Client is considered enrolled only once the agreed fee (or the agreed initial payment under an approved Tabby/Tamara plan) has been received and confirmed. No session will begin before payment is confirmed.
termsPage.c3: Seedrix accepts card, bank transfer, or approved Tabby/Tamara installment plans only. Seedrix does not accept cash under any circumstance. Every payment is matched to an official Seedrix invoice.
termsPage.c4: The Client may request to defer a course or package in writing (email) for up to 6 months (180 days) from the date of the request. Deferral requests made verbally are not accepted. Fees already paid are non-refundable but remain valid as credit for the deferral period.
termsPage.c5: For VIP, one-to-one, and online sessions, the Client must notify Seedrix in writing at least 24 hours before a scheduled session to reschedule. Sessions cancelled with less notice are forfeited and deducted from the total package. Up to 2 reschedules per calendar month are permitted with adequate notice.
termsPage.c6: Seedrix may change the assigned Trainer or adjust the schedule with reasonable notice where operationally necessary. Concerns may be raised with the Manager, whose decision on scheduling matters is final.
termsPage.c7: Any required textbooks or materials are advised separately and are not included in the session fee unless stated on the invoice.
termsPage.c8: The Client, and any minor under their care, are expected to treat Trainers and staff with respect. Seedrix reserves the right to suspend or terminate services, without refund, for conduct that is abusive, unsafe, or disruptive to others.
termsPage.c9: Once a course or package has commenced, fees paid are non-refundable. If the Client cancels before commencement for reasons not related to a breach of this Agreement by Seedrix, the amount paid remains as credit, usable toward any Seedrix service for up to 6 months (180 days) from the invoice date, consistent with UAE Federal Law No. 15 of 2020 on Consumer Protection and its executive regulations.
termsPage.c10: Personal data, including that of minors, is collected and used only to deliver and manage the Client's services, consistent with UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 (the PDPL).
termsPage.c11: By signing below, the Client confirms they have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions in full.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.intro: Seedrix LLC ("Seedrix", "we") processes personal data in line with UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data (PDPL). This policy covers data collected through this website's inquiry and payment forms.
privacyPage.who: The data controller is Seedrix LLC, License No. 2648158.01, Shams Free Zone, Sharjah, UAE. Contact: {email} / {phone}.
privacyPage.what: Inquiry form: full name, mobile number, email, service of interest, preferred Emirate, preferred delivery mode, and the language you used on the site. Payment and invoice flows: the same contact fields plus invoice number, amount, payment method, and payment status. We do not collect card numbers on our servers — card and BNPL data is handled by our payment gateway (Network International N-Genius).
privacyPage.why: To respond to your inquiry within 10 minutes, match you with a trainer, issue official invoices, confirm payment, and meet our legal record-keeping duties. We do not sell personal data.
privacyPage.how: Inquiry records are kept for 24 months from last contact, unless a longer period is required for an active enrolment or a legal claim. Paid invoices and payment records are retained for at least 5 years to meet UAE accounting and tax record requirements, then deleted or anonymised.
privacyPage.share: Seedrix consultants (Recruits) assigned to your inquiry; trainers only to the extent needed to deliver sessions; our hosting, email, database, and payment processors acting on our instructions. We do not share data with advertisers.
privacyPage.rights: Under the PDPL you may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data, and object to or restrict certain processing, subject to our legal retention duties. Contact {email}. We will respond within the timeframes required by law.
privacyPage.minors: Tutoring inquiries often concern a child. We collect parent or guardian contact details on the form — not the child's civil ID. Any further child data needed to deliver a service is collected by a consultant on the follow-up call, used only to deliver that service, and stored with the same safeguards.
privacyPage.cookies: We use privacy-friendly analytics (Vercel Analytics) to understand page performance. We do not run advertising cookies or third-party ad trackers.
